description: `@api.access` is the API's answer to `whoami`, not the token's: only the API can read whether the account is still enabled.
purpose: Signs the operator in, then switches between sign-in, access check, refusal and the console
name: App

description: AppHeader
purpose: Sticky header: brand, the five routes, and the signed-in operator
name: AppHeader

description: An unknown route renders `Page`, the not-found screen, by CML's dotted-prefix fallback.
purpose: The signed-in console: header, then the page the hash route names
name: AppShell

description: Wraps the whole app, so `@toaster`, `@nav` and `@browser` resolve from anywhere below it.
purpose: Platform services every screen relies on: toasts, hash routing and the browser bridge
name: Infra

description: Page.Checking
purpose: Between the token and the API's answer: nothing to show yet but that it is working
name: Page.Checking

description: Page.Denied
purpose: Signed in, and the API said no: a disabled account, no role, or the API unreachable
name: Page.Denied

description: Page.SignIn
purpose: The signed-out screen: what this is, and the one way in
name: Page.SignIn

description: Page
purpose: Not found: what any unknown hash route renders, by dotted-prefix fallback
name: Page

description: UserMenu
purpose: Who is signed in, with which roles, and the way out
name: UserMenu

description: AuditList
purpose: What went wrong, one per line: when and where, then the reason. A rejected send names its target and method; a failed item, its stage and post
name: AuditList

description: `chart` is `{ slices, background }` from `PipelineService`; an empty chart says so rather than drawing a hole.
purpose: A donut chart with its legend, drawn as one CSS conic-gradient
name: Donut

description: ErrorBanner
purpose: An inline failure, in plain words, beside the block it belongs to
name: ErrorBanner

description: PageTitle
purpose: A page's title row: title, one line of context, and its actions on the right
name: PageTitle

description: StatCard
purpose: One headline figure with its label and a short note
name: StatCard

description: StatusBadge
purpose: A record's status as a coloured pill; unknown values are neutral
name: StatusBadge

description: Reads `@pipeline`; the panel shown while no stage is selected. Its grids follow the panel's width, not the viewport's.
purpose: Pipeline health at a glance: the 24 h figures, the two charts and the latest messages
name: DashboardPanel

description: With no stage selected, the panel holds the overview: the 24 h figures, the two charts and the latest messages. Select a stage; the panel then holds its figures and its actions. The selected stage is `?node=` on the hash route, so a reload or a shared link opens the same one. Figures refresh every 30 s.
purpose: The whole pipeline as one live diagram beside the overview, with every manual trigger on the node it acts on
name: Page.Dashboard

description: Reads `@item.detail`; opened from a queue row of the Pipeline panel or a failed item of the Audit page. Only an admin saves, and only a waiting or failed item; the API re-checks both and the stage's schema.
purpose: One ingest item whole: where it stands, its payload, and a form over the payload's text
name: PipelineItem

description: A stage shows its count, and its queue count on its top-right corner when it has one. Pressing it selects it. The caption is cut at one line; the panel shows it whole.
purpose: One node of the pipeline diagram: a stage
name: PipelineNode

description: Reads `@pipeline`. Admin actions render only for an admin; the API re-checks the role regardless.
purpose: What the selected node holds and what an operator may do to it; with none selected, the overview
name: PipelinePanel

description: Opened from a row of a node's list; mounted once per `RecordService`. Mounted beside the panel, not in it: the panel is sticky, and the header would cover a modal inside it.
purpose: One source or target in a modal: every field, which an editor saves or deletes
name: RecordModal

description: Reads `@sources` and reloads it each time the tab opens. Its actions sit on the tabs' right, in `PipelinePanel`. Only an editor ticks rows; the API re-checks the role regardless.
purpose: The Scrape node's All sources tab: every reader and status in a table; a click on an id opens `RecordModal`
name: SourcesTable

description: Reads `@targets` and reloads it each time the node is selected. Only an editor adds, ticks and deletes; the API re-checks the role regardless.
purpose: The Publish node's target channels: a table to add to, delete from in bulk and export; a click on an id opens `RecordModal`
name: TelegramTargets

description: Reads `@audit`; a row opens in `@item`. Admin actions render only for an admin; the API re-checks the role regardless.
purpose: Every stage's failed items: message, cause, the model's reading, and what an admin may do
name: FailedItems

description: Reads the `error` items through `inspectErrors` and `audit` through `loadAudit`; audit entries go after 30 days by a TTL policy.
purpose: What went wrong: the failed items an operator may still act on, and the record kept for 30 days
name: Page.Audit

description: The tab is `?status=` on the hash route, so a reload or a shared link shows the same one.
purpose: The Messages table by status tab, with Publish now on the backlog for an admin
name: Page.Messages

description: On a phone the cell carries its column's name, since there is no header row; the row's first cell is the card's title and needs none. Edits go to `@grid.edit` on every keystroke; nothing is sent until the row's Save.
purpose: One table cell: an input where the operator may write, a badge for a status, text otherwise
name: RecordCell

description: On a phone each record is a card with the id as its title; from `md` the same markup is a table with a header and a filter row. Reads the page's `@grid`. The empty state renders inside the table, so the filters stay reachable.
purpose: The records table: search, per-column filters, sort, selection, inline edit and export
name: RecordsTable
